name: SoftWar
source:
John Doe, a serious programmer boy who lives and works alone, one day finds himself downloading the program that changes his life forever: the ILOVEYOU virus!

Getting infected by a virus is the last thing a programmer wants to happen to his computer! Unless it actually turns out to be useful!

Find out more about the ILOVEYOU virus or "ILY" and their quest to discover the cyberworld!

Follow their adventures as they go over using their Future Artificial Intelligence programs, in the Grid cyber-world, fighting virtual battles called SoftWars!

[Edited from [url=https://zankizuna.itch.io/softwar]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
严肃的程序员约翰·多伊独自生活、工作。某天，他下载了一个将永远改变人生的程序：ILOVEYOU病毒！

电脑感染病毒，是程序员最不希望发生的事！除非这个病毒实际上有用！

了解更多关于ILOVEYOU病毒（或“ILY”）以及它们探索网络世界的故事！

跟随他们的冒险：他们使用未来人工智能程序，在网格赛博世界中进行虚拟战斗——“软战争”！

[改编自[url=https://zankizuna.itch.io/softwar]Itch.io[/url]]
